any: Past the arch, Ichibangai runs north between the signs. Every doorway is somebody's idea of a good night out.
The red arch of Kabukicho Ichibangai. It has stood at the mouth of the street since 1969.
night: Kabukicho's arch with its bulbs on. Everything behind it is a sign for something.

any: The head over Central Road. Twelve metres of it on a terrace eight floors up, glaring down the street since 2015.
Shinjuku Gyoen, by the pond. The towers stand behind the trees and none of their noise gets in.
The footbridge at Shinanomachi. The tower with the clock stands on the skyline, small and exact.
